title: full-abstract-field-6-settings-20261023

design.question: On the abstract field preset, with every kind of agent and money following earnings, which of the six rule settings gets furthest?
design.compare: Traditional, OSO (immediate), OSO (choice), Flow-back, finished-only, No flow-back, immediate, No flow-back, choice
design.measure: all of hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, money to the main level, waste

answer: Best overall: OSO. Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI and money to the main level; clearly worse on waste. (6 measures; a clear difference is more than 2.6 standard errors.)
answers: hardest level: 8.00 against traditional 3.68, clearly better.
targets solved: 3.63 against traditional 0.67, clearly better.
bounty value: 1859 against traditional 343, clearly better.
money to the main level: 401 against traditional 686, clearly better.
caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out, not that they work.
